->Undefiled, pure light, the sun of wisdom breaks all darkness. It subdues disasters of wind and fire and universally illuminates the<-
->world.<-
->The essence of compassion is like the rumble of thunder; the intent of kindness is like a wondrous, great cloud. It pours down the <term>Dharma</term> <gloss>Buddhist teachings</gloss> rain of nectar to extinguish the flames of<-
->affliction.<-
->In legal disputes before officials, or in the terrors of military ranks, by thinking of the power of <term>Avalokitesvara</term> <gloss>the Bodhisattva of Compassion</gloss>, all enemies will<-
->retreat and scatter.<-
->Wondrous Sound, Observer of the World's Sounds, Brahma Sound, Sea-tide Sound—these surpass all worldly sounds. For this reason, one should always<-
->mind them.<-
->In every thought, let no doubt arise. <term>Avalokitesvara</term>, the pure sage, can serve as a refuge and protector in times of suffering, distress, and the danger of<-
->death.<-
->Possessing every merit and looking upon all beings with eyes of compassion, the accumulation of blessings is as boundless as the ocean. Therefore, one should<-
->prostrate.<-

---

->At that time, <term>Earth-Holding Bodhisattva</term> <gloss>Dharanindhara, a high-ranking being who protects the earth</gloss> rose from his seat, came forward, and said to the Buddha: "World-Honored One!<-
->If there are sentient beings who hear this chapter on the sovereign deeds of <term>Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva</term> and the supernatural power of his universal manifestations,<-
->one should know that the merit of these people is not small." When the Buddha spoke this "Universal Gate" chapter,<-
->eighty-four thousand sentient beings in the assembly all gave rise to the mind of <term>Anuttara-samyak-sambodhi</term> <gloss>the unexcelled, perfect, and complete enlightenment of a Buddha</gloss>.<-

<summary>This page concludes the verses praising Avalokitesvara's saving powers and records the assembly's spiritual awakening after hearing the teaching. Earth-Holding Bodhisattva affirms the great merit of those who encounter this chapter of the Lotus Sutra.</summary>
<keywords>Avalokitesvara, Earth-Holding Bodhisattva, Universal Gate, Dharma Rain, enlightenment, merit, compassion</keywords>
